summary: Fact, correction: nol_screener.json shows ATNM allowance at 26932 percent of a $431,000 DTA field. The FY25 10-K accession 0001213900-26-036504, period 2025-12-31, reports gross DTA $116,508,000, net DTA $431,000, and a valuation allowance of $116,077,000. Inference: the screener put the net tag in the gross field. 26932 percent is not a filed allowance rate.
